basic_info.description: Perched atop a classic 1920s building in one of Russian Hill's most coveted locations, this light-filled 2BD/1BA loft-like penthouse has an open floor plan that blends historic charm with modern comfort. In 2022 this TIC  was fully renovated with features such as double-pane windows that capture stunning views of the Golden Gate Bridge, the Bay, the Headlands, and Sutro Tower. Original details like hardwood floors and period molding are complemented by thoughtful updates, including an in-unit washer/dryer, a remodeled bath with a deep soaking tub, as well as a modern kitchen with updated appliances.    Set within a secure, gated building with an intercom entry and a peaceful garden walkway, this home also includes large, secure designated storage and access to a shared rooftop with panoramic city views.  Designated roof rights for this unit provide the option to install solar panels. Parking is available for an additional cost. With a 97 Walk Score and easy access to cable car and MUNI lines, you're steps from the best of Russian Hill's shops, cafes, and restaurants.A Sirkin TIC agreement is in place, and the HOA financials are professionally managed by HOMworks.
